title: 第7章 撑死的鼠鼠
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
林奇沿着街道跑了大半晌，问遍了城南的小酒馆和杂货铺，脚底板都磨得发疼，终于在一家飘着麦酒香的“老橡树酒馆”里，看到了那个熟悉的高大身影。

    猎户大叔正坐在靠窗的木桌旁，面前摆着一个空酒杯，粗糙的手指摩挲着杯沿，眼神望着窗外的街道发呆。

    林奇心里一喜，推门快步走了进去，径直朝着他的方向奔去，坐下时带起一阵风，惊得邻桌的酒客抬头看了一眼。

    “酒保，上一桶麦酒！” 林奇朝着柜台方向喊了一声。

    很快，酒保扛着一桶沉甸甸的麦酒走了过来，“砰”地一声放在桌上，酒液晃出了几滴，溅在木桌上。

    林奇将麦酒推到猎户大叔面前，脸上堆起笑容。

    看着将满满一大桶麦酒推到自己面前，猎人大叔挠了挠头，有些疑惑。

    “小伙子，你这是有事？”

    林奇拿起大叔的空酒杯，满满倒了一杯麦酒递过去，语气自然得像是在和老朋友聊天。

    “叔，我就是想问问您几天前卖我的卡兽从哪里猎杀的。女朋友正好快过生日了，我打算多弄些皮毛做件衣服。”

    “哦？你要很多皮毛？”

    猎户原本有些呆滞的眼神瞬间亮了起来。

    那灼灼的目光落在林奇身上，看得他心里微微发紧。

    “是啊，但我需要颜色好看的那种。就好比上次的狐狸，它尾巴是粉色的。女生嘛，都喜欢粉色狐裘大衣。”

    “有！俺有！”

    猎户大叔猛地一拍桌子。

    他兴奋地往前凑了凑，压低声音说道：

    “俺家里还囤着好多低阶卡兽呢，身上或多或少都带点粉色皮毛。

    本来想等攒多了一起拿到其他地方卖，你要是需要，俺现在就能带你去看！”

    “真的？”

    林奇心里一阵激动。

    他原本只想着从大叔嘴里套出猎捕狐狸的地址，没想到还有意外收获，这下说不定能省下不少功夫。

    他强压着心底的喜悦，脸上依旧保持着平静。

    “那太好了叔，麻烦您带我去看看，要是合适，我全都要了！”

    “走走走，这就去！”

    猎户大叔一把抱起桌上的麦酒桶，扛在肩上，脚步轻快地往酒馆外走，丝毫不见刚才的沉闷。

    ......

    二人一前一后朝着城西走去，越走周围的房屋越稀疏，最后出了城，来到一片靠近黑风森林的空地。

    远远地，林奇就看到一个用粗木头围起来的篱笆院子，院子门口挂着几串风干的兽骨，在风里轻轻晃动，发出“咯吱咯吱”的声响。

    “到了！”

    猎户大叔推开篱笆门，一股浓郁的血腥味扑面而来。

    院子里的地面上铺着一层干草，上面摆放着十几只死去的卡兽。

    周围还挖着不少陷阱，里面插着削尖的木刺，显然是为了防止森林里的卡兽闯进来偷食。

    “这些都是俺最近猎杀的低阶卡兽，本来想晒成肉干慢慢卖，你要是需要皮毛，就都卖给你！”

    猎户大叔拍了拍身边一只卡兽，语气里带着几分得意。

    “这……”

    林奇的目光扫过院子里的卡兽。

    掘土豆鼠、跳跳兔、还有青叶羊，这些卡兽身上都有着或多或少的粉色皮毛。

    他心里瞬间激动起来，但脸上依旧装作镇定，故意皱着眉打量着这些卡兽。

    “叔啊，没有狐狸类的卡兽了吗？我还是更想要狐狸皮毛，做出来的大衣更好看。”

    猎户大叔有些遗憾地摇了摇头：“真没有了，这几天森林里的狐狸都躲得深，俺就抓到一只，这些就是所有的猎物了。”

    林奇叹了口气，上前用脚尖轻轻踢了踢地上的跳跳兔和青叶羊。

    “这跳跳兔的皮毛倒还行，做个坎肩也好看，青叶羊的羊毛多，能织件毛衣。”
content_en:
Lynch ran along the street for a long time, checking all the taverns and grocery stores in the south of the city. The soles of his feet were so painful that he finally saw the familiar tall figure in the "Old Oak Tavern" that smelled of ale.

Uncle Orion was sitting at the wooden table by the window, with an empty wine glass in front of him. He rubbed the rim of the glass with his rough fingers and stared blankly at the street outside the window.

Lin Qi was overjoyed, opened the door and walked in quickly, running straight in his direction. When he sat down, there was a gust of wind, which made the drinker at the next table look up in surprise.

"Bartender, bring a barrel of ale!" Lynch shouted towards the counter.

Soon, the bartender came over with a heavy bucket of ale and placed it on the table with a bang. A few drops of the wine sloshed out and splashed on the wooden table.

Lynch pushed the ale in front of Uncle Orion with a smile on his face.

Seeing a vat full of ale being pushed in front of him, the hunter uncle scratched his head and felt a little confused.

"Young man, is something wrong with you?"

Lin Qi picked up the uncle's empty wine glass, filled it with a glass of ale and handed it over, speaking in a natural tone as if he was chatting with an old friend.

"Uncle, I just want to ask you where you hunted the Kaju you sold me a few days ago. My girlfriend's birthday is coming soon, and I plan to get more furs to make clothes."

"Oh? You want a lot of fur?"

Orion's originally dull eyes lit up instantly.

That scorching gaze fell on Lin Qi, making him feel slightly nervous.

"Yes, but I need something with a nice color. Just like the fox last time, its tail was pink. Girls all like pink fox fur coats."

"Yes! I do!"

Uncle Orion slammed the table.

He moved forward excitedly, lowered his voice and said:

"I still have a lot of low-level card beasts at home, and they all have some pink fur on them.

I originally wanted to wait until I had enough money to sell it to other places. If you need it, I can take you to see it now!"

"Really?"

Lin Qi felt excited.

He originally only wanted to get the address of fox hunting from his uncle, but he didn't expect to get an unexpected harvest. This might save him a lot of effort.

He suppressed the joy in his heart and remained calm on his face.

"That's great, uncle. Please take me to see it. If it's suitable, I want them all!"

"Let's go, let's go!"

Uncle Orion picked up the ale barrel on the table, put it on his shoulder, and walked briskly out of the tavern, without feeling the dullness at all.

...

The two of them walked towards the west of the city one after the other. The houses around them became sparse as they walked, and finally they left the city and came to an open space near the Black Wind Forest.

From a distance, Lynch saw a fenced yard surrounded by thick wood. Several strings of dried animal bones were hung at the door of the yard, swaying gently in the wind and making a "creaking" sound.

"We're here!"

Uncle Orion pushed open the fence door, and a strong smell of blood hit his face.

There was a layer of hay on the ground in the yard, and a dozen dead card animals were placed on it.

There are also many traps dug around, with sharpened wooden thorns inserted in them, obviously to prevent the forest beasts from breaking in and stealing food.

"These are the low-level beasts I hunted recently. I originally wanted to dry them into dried meat and sell them slowly. If you need the skins, I will sell them to you!"

Uncle Orion patted a card beast next to him, with a bit of pride in his tone.

"This..."

Lin Qi's eyes swept over the card beasts in the yard.

Digger mice, jumping rabbits, and green leaf sheep, these animals all have more or less pink fur on their bodies.

He was instantly excited, but his face still pretended to be calm, and he deliberately frowned and looked at these card beasts.

"Uncle, are there no fox-like beasts? I still want fox fur more. The coat will look better."

Uncle Orion shook his head with some regret: "There are really none. The foxes in the forest have been hiding deep these days. I just caught one. These are all the prey."

Lin Qi sighed, stepped forward and gently kicked the jumping rabbit and green leaf sheep on the ground with his toes.

"The Legging Rabbit's fur is not bad. It would look good as a waistcoat. The Green Leaf Sheep has a lot of wool and can be used to knit a sweater."
